buildCommand: if [ ! -x flutter/bin/flutter ]; then git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable flutter; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=FIREBASE_APPCHECK_RECAPTCHA_KEY=$FIREBASE_APPCHECK_RECAPTCHA_KEY
